description:
## Summary

With every invocation point re-homed to Radicle mechanics, the connector-era surface is removed and conformance is re-pointed: the gates that policed the connector model are replaced by Radicle-era gates that protect the new invariants — including the mechanically checked absence of the old surface. After this unit, the forge/non-forge mechanic split no longer exists: all mechanics are ordinary manifest-registered runtime actions.

Part of: #538.

## Scope

- `schemas/forge-capability/` (vendored contract) and its loader tooling
- The forge-operation registry injection in the workflow-contract tooling
- `tooling/conformance.py` gate set; `tests/` connector-model tests, provider-named fixtures, retired-era bytecode residue
- Installer / runtime-bundle content and upgrade convergence
- `manifest.toml` comments

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] The vendored forge-capability schema and its loader are gone; the forge-operation registry injection is gone; the mechanic registry contains only manifest-declared mechanics.
- [ ] Connector-era conformance gates (capability provenance pin, exactly-eight-operations, handle-drift-to-vendored-contract, forge-leakage token scan, retired-asset list) are replaced by Radicle-era gates protecting the new invariants: handle-grammar validation, mechanics-registry integrity, and asserted absence of connector-era surfaces (no vendored capability contract, no forge-operation names in the registry, no connector-model documentation obligations).
- [ ] A manifest or configuration that declares connector-era surfaces (forge operations as mechanics, forge tags) is rejected loudly by conformance, not silently accepted.
- [ ] Connector-model test assertions are retired; provider-named and retired-era fixtures are gone; orphaned retired-era bytecode residue is gone from the tree.
- [ ] Installer output and the installed runtime bundle carry no adapter-era surfaces; upgrading a connector-era install converges cleanly, pruning stale surfaces.
- [ ] Conformance and the full test suite are green after removal.

## Contract inputs

- **Behavior:** the absence gates fail on a tree that reintroduces any connector-era surface — proven by negative fixtures.
- **Documentation:** the schema index and conformance docs describe the Radicle-era gate set as current.
- **Code quality:** no dormant path, no dead tooling retained "just in case" (Simplicity; `~/.groundwork/principles/`).

## Dependencies

Depends on: #601, #603, #602, #604, #605 (every invocation point re-homed before the contract they invoke is removed).
